methodology:
Bumitama Agri (SGX-listed, IDR-reporting; dual-currency in this comp set) operates 187,021 hectares planted across Indonesia per FY24 disclosure. Geographic split disclosed in annual report:
- Central Kalimantan: 56% (10+ named mills including Pundu Nabatindo, Katari Agro, Gunung Makmur, Bukit Makmur, Sungai Cempaga, Selucing, Kotawaringin, Lamandau)
- West Kalimantan: 43% (multiple mills including Tonam Raya)
- Riau: 1% (smallest position)

4-row breakdown reflects this geography plus a separate plasma partnership row (mill processing rights without land ownership). Total 17 palm oil mills with 1,165 tonnes/hour capacity = ~7M MT FFB annual throughput.

The plasma partnership row is marked at lower per-acre to reflect that Bumitama doesn't own the underlying land — these are smallholder partnership areas where Bumitama provides technical support + mill processing.

Weighted average plantation age 13.8 years (per FY24 disclosure) — mature with future replant cycle approaching.
